title: Terrazzo Switch Table
body_html:
Mix Materials for a Stunning Side table

A stunning blend of classic craftsmanship and contemporary design. Embrace the allure of terrazzo, a material used for centuries in architecture and interior design. Crafted with a hexagonal terrazzo top, meticulously adorned with intricate pattern lines, this table is a true masterpiece that harmonizes tradition and innovation. Whether you're designing for your home or a commercial setting, the Switch Table's terrazzo elegance will elevate your space.

title: Tube Lounge 2.0
body_html:
The Tube Lounge 2.0 revisits a familiar silhouette with a more considered set of proportions. Its updated design brings a smaller overall depth, a slightly higher seat, and a taller profile, creating a lounge chair that feels relaxed without taking up quite as much room.

Built from powder coated aluminum tube, the frame gives the chair its clean, continuous form while keeping the construction durable and lightweight. The seat and backrest are upholstered in vegan leather, available in a variety of colors to suit everything from quiet residential interiors to more expressive commercial spaces.

Still unmistakably part of the Tube Collection, the Tube Lounge 2.0 balances sculptural lines with everyday comfort. It is a revised take on a Bend Goods original, designed to bring a little more flexibility to how lounge seating fits into a space.

title: 86" Hinoki Table
body_html:
The Hinoki Dining Table brings the collection’s considered approach to material and proportion into a larger, more communal form. Made from ash wood, its generous 86 inch surface is supported by two substantial wood bases, creating a balanced silhouette with a quietly architectural presence.

Available in Natural Ash Wood and Black, the table is designed for everyday dining, gathering, and the spaces in between. Its straightforward construction and restrained detailing let the character of the wood take the lead, bringing warmth and structure to both residential and hospitality settings.

title: Folding Freddie Seat Pad
body_html: Give Folding Freddie a little extra comfort. Designed to fit the Folding Freddie Chair, this seatpad is upholstered in durable Sunbrella fabric and made for easy, everyday seating indoors or out. Available in Black, Granite, Tan, and Forest Green, it adds a soft layer to Freddie’s sculptural steel frame while keeping its clean, foldable design intact.

title: Jolene Upholstered Dining Chair
body_html:
Modern Scandinavian-Inspired Upholstery

The Jolene Dining Chair combines gentle curves, clean lines, and modern geometry, creating a bold yet inviting presence at any table. Drawing inspiration from Scandinavian furniture design, it blends minimalist aesthetics with warm, natural materials and ergonomic comfort, ideal for contemporary dining spaces.

Fully upholstered in durable indoor performance fabric, Jolene provides long-lasting comfort. Its sustainably certified wood frame and rounded, grounded wood feet add warmth, stability, and sculptural character. Lightweight yet strong, this chair exemplifies the perfect balance of form and function central to Scandinavian design, offering timeless elegance and refined presence.

Whether placed in a modern dining room, cozy kitchen, or stylish café, Jolene brings sculptural sophistication, inviting comfort, and a design-forward aesthetic to any space.

title: Cono Side Table
body_html:
Cono Side Table, the perfect companion to its Bistro counterpart. Crafted with a wire cone base and a powder-coated steel frame, this table boasts a sleek silhouette that exudes strength and elegance.


Designed for compact spaces, the Cono Side Table is ideal for design enthusiasts living or working in limited areas. Its compact base makes it a versatile addition, fitting perfectly between two armchairs to create a cozy cocktail corner in your living room.
With a durable ceramic stone top, this table is built to withstand the rigors of daily use. Resistant to scratches, stains, and UV rays, it is suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings, ensuring longevity and versatility.


Easy to clean and environmentally friendly, the Cono Side Table seamlessly combines timeless style with practical functionality, making it an essential accessory for any home or office space.

title: Slim Cube Ottoman
body_html:
Inspired by 70s Italian Luxury Furniture

The collection features six different pieces, all following rounded - square shapes that are designed to be separated and re-arranged - allowing for endless modular layouts for any project or space. The sofa is like sitting on a cloud with its deep lounge seating, rounded shapes, and low profile.  The sofa features a visually interesting back and side detail making it a centerpiece of any home. Made to order, with an array of fabric selections to choose from, the multi piece collection is available to purchase individually or together.

Made in Los Angeles at Bend Goods very own upholstery factory. The Nanda Sofa is completely different from the signature wire furniture that Bend Goods is known for but still takes cues from our well known aesthetic.

title: Coffee Table
body_html:
The "TEA CUP" SILHOUETTE COFFEE TABLE

The Coffee Table, inspired by The "Tea Cup" Desk found at a famous building lobby by architect and designer Eero Saarinen with the wire pattern of the signature Lucy Chair. An elegant arrangement that doesn't overwhelm a simple space, it's a 36 inch round table that offers an open aesthetic so your interior home won't feel crowded. Powder coated versions for indoor or outdoor.
